title: Grateful Dead Live at Washington University on 1969-04-17
lineage: Transfer Info: Cassette Master > DAT (44.1k) > FLAC  Mastering Info: FLAC > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Nice soundboard capture of a high‑energy late‑Live/Dead era show with a smoking Cryptical > Caution and strong Dark Stars.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean SBD that fans describe as “nice” and generally sounding good throughout.  Musically the night shines on the Cryptical reprise leading into Caution and a powerful Dark Stars, though some listeners note a weak It’s‑a‑Sin‑driven St Stephen’s and an unsatisfying Eleven fake‑out.  Overall the performance is high‑energy with memorable moments despite a few uneven spots.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the show and the soundboard quality, highlighting strong performances; a couple of critiques keep the rating from higher tiers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners call it a "nice SBD" and say the show sounds good overall; no specific issues like drop‑outs or muffiness are reported.

poor_songs: It’s a Sin diverted St Stephen's
show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy set with strong transitions, especially the Cryptical > Caution sequence; some later jams felt less focused.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass drive is highlighted during the Cryptical reprise and his decision to push into Caution is noted as a key moment.
